_comment: Spawn odds, respawn times and extra drops (restart the server after editing). Each spawn point picks its next monster by weight every time it respawns; weightMultiplier multiplies a monster's weight at every point it can appear at (2 = about twice as likely there, 1 = unchanged, 0 = never). respawnSeconds: seconds from the kill until that spawn point comes back when this monster died (null = the default below). Under spawnPoints, a respawnSeconds for one spawn point (by spawnId) beats both. now: the monster's chance at its best spawn point today and the live respawn time Master's Grimoire lists, for reference. useLiveRespawnTimes true uses those live times for every spawn point without a value here; false keeps defaultRespawnSeconds for all of them. extraDrops: items added to the monster's own loot, each rolled on every kill, e.g. {"id": 15057, "name": "Diamond", "chance": 25, "quantity": 1} (chance in percent, 0-100; quantity defaults to 1); they're dealt out among a group like the rest of the loot. Each extra drop is rolled on its own (a kill can give several, or none); give the monster a noDropChance (percent) instead to get at most one: that percent gives nothing, otherwise one of its extraDrops, picked with their chances as weights (null = each rolled on its own). Under spawnPoints, y sets the height whatever spawns there stands at (a monster stuck in the floor or roof) and scale its model size (1 = normal), for that spot only. startHighTier: true = at every server start the spot begins with a random 4, 5 or 6 star (an equal chance for each star it has), then respawns with the usual odds. startAnyTier: true = the same over every star the spot has, placeholders included (the Carrowmore gold bosses start as the boss or its placeholder, even odds). divine: true = takes Divine Strike (the set weapons' proc and the set auras' glows with a Divine light strike); every monster not marked true takes none. Add an entry with divine true to give one more monster the weakness. Any monster can be added by its id. removeDrops: item ids taken out of the monster's official loot (the 3* Stonevale placeholders: the six Disc Fragments). chestChance: percent chance of a random event Mystery Chest per kill.
